card.text: Explore Mercury in 3D with cssEarth. Inspect the smallest planet, its cratered surface, and the extreme conditions closest to the Sun.

introduction.text: Closest to the Sun, Mercury is the smallest planet: a cratered terrestrial world with a large metallic core and extreme surface temperatures.

normal.title: MDIS Global Basemap BDR
normal.summary: Brightness at 750 nm varies with the surface and the lighting when each image was taken. The mosaic is grayscale.

enhanced.title: MDIS Enhanced Color Mosaic
enhanced.summary: Colors distinguish surface materials. Missing polar color is reconstructed from nearby imagery and terrain, not observed.

topography.title: MDIS Color Shaded Relief
topography.summary: Colors show elevation, while shading makes slopes visible. Both describe the terrain; they do not depict its visible color.

interior.title: Interior structure model
interior.summary: A large metallic core sits inside a rocky outer shell. Layer sizes follow the structural model; colors identify each layer.
